correctness.rationale: Actual seven-file Git tree, RESULT.md proof, check.py and verification record inspected. Starting-side observations at t have floor(t/2)+1 counts and other side ceil(t/2), independent uniform coupon collectors; iid counts yield a binomial mixture. The discrete coupon-completion CDF is log-concave, so its product at fixed total counts is maximized at the balanced split, proving all-horizon stochastic order. Exact gamma/Poissonization identity Delta=nH_(2n)-E max(T,Tprime)=1/2 sum_{k,l} p(k)p(l)(E|S_k-S_lprime|-|k-l|); local Gumbel coupon-completion mass, gamma-difference normal limit, and Bernstein off-diagonal/tail localization give Delta/log n->(int g^2)(int m)=1/4. The tie contribution is O(1/n), establishing the half-log gap. Boundary n=2 and fixed first vertex correctly handled. Independently recomputed 134 exact fixed-horizon stochastic-order checks; they corroborate but do not prove the infinite claim.
